subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord gain a default-off silent audio preflight history mode for requireMention channels, and what consent, retention, cost, and visibility limits should it enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but silently processing and retaining unmentioned speech changes privacy, cost, and configuration policy rather than only repairing broken existing behavior.

options.title: Approve scoped Discord policy
options.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit allowlist, size, retention, provider, schema, docs, and regression-test boundaries before implementation.

options.title: Defer to cross-channel media history design
options.body: Keep this as product input until maintainers define shared media-history enrichment semantics across Discord, WhatsApp, Signal, and similar channels.

options.title: Decline silent unmentioned transcription
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers decide unmentioned speech should never be transcribed or retained without direct invocation.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped Discord policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit allowlist, size, retention, provider, schema, docs, and regression-test boundaries before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal for Discord audio preflight and related policy decisions points to steipete’s recent fixes and issue-review comments.
